description: Residue-level mapping of the crown/collagen-binding region: identity to ALPL and distance to the catalytic core for every ALPP residue
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

shell = json.load(open("out/plap_shell.json")); maps = json.load(open("out/alpp_maps.json"))
sd = {int(k): v for k, v in shell["shell_dist"].items()}
ss = {int(k): v for k, v in shell["seqstruct"].items()}
AL = {int(k): v for k, v in maps["ALPL"].items()}      # UniProt-numbered ALPP -> ALPL
AG = {int(k): v for k, v in maps["ALPG"].items()}
OFF = 22                                                # mature = UniProt - 22

# sanity: catalytic Ser92 (mature) must be S in both structure and UniProt+22
print("check Ser92:", ss.get(92), AL.get(92+OFF))

CROWN = range(366, 431)      # mature crown domain, operational definition
rows = []
for m in sorted(sd):
    u = m + OFF
    a = AL.get(u)
    rows.append(dict(mature=m, uniprot=u,
                     alpp=ss.get(m), alpl=(a[2] if a else None),
                     alpl_pos=(a[1] if a else None),
                     identical=(None if not a else int(ss.get(m) == a[2])),
                     dist_core=sd[m],
                     region=("crown_366_430" if m in CROWN else "rest"),
                     in_6A=int(m in shell["near6"]), in_10A=int(m in shell["near10"])))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
crown = df[df.region == "crown_366_430"].dropna(subset=["identical"])
rest  = df[df.region == "rest"].dropna(subset=["identical"])

print("\n=== Crown domain (mature 366-430), residue level ===")
print(f"residues aligned to ALPL : {len(crown)}")
print(f"identical to ALPL        : {int(crown.identical.sum())} ({100*crown.identical.mean():.1f}%)")
print(f"rest of mature chain     : {int(rest.identical.sum())}/{len(rest)} ({100*rest.identical.mean():.1f}%)")
tab = [[int(crown.identical.sum()), len(crown)-int(crown.identical.sum())],
       [int(rest.identical.sum()),  len(rest)-int(rest.identical.sum())]]
orr, p = fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"Fisher crown vs rest: OR={orr:.2f}, p={p:.3g}", tab)

print(f"\ncrown distance to catalytic core: min={crown.dist_core.min():.2f} A "
      f"median={crown.dist_core.median():.2f} max={crown.dist_core.max():.2f}")
print("crown residues within 10 A of core:", sorted(crown[crown.dist_core < 10].mature.tolist()))
print("crown residues within 15 A of core:", sorted(crown[crown.dist_core < 15].mature.tolist()))

# the 6 A shell: how far is it from the crown?
n6 = df[df.in_6A == 1]
print("\n6 A shell residues inside crown:", sorted(n6[n6.region=='crown_366_430'].mature.tolist()))

# divergent crown positions that are nonetheless closest to the core
cdiv = crown[crown.identical == 0].sort_values("dist_core")
print("\n10 most core-proximal ALPP/ALPL differences inside the crown:")
print(cdiv.head(10)[["mature","alpp","alpl","dist_core"]].to_string(index=False))

df.to_csv("out/crown_collagen_region_residues.csv", index=False)
crown.to_csv("out/crown_domain_detail.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 7.5), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1]})
col = np.where(df.identical == 1, "#4878a8", "#c0504d")
ax[0].scatter(df.mature, df.dist_core, c=col, s=11)
ax[0].axvspan(366, 430, color="#f0c419", alpha=0.25)
ax[0].axhline(6, ls="--", lw=1, c="k"); ax[0].axhline(10, ls=":", lw=1, c="k")
ax[0].text(398, 46, "crown domain 366-430", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax[0].text(5, 6.8, "6 A shell", fontsize=8); ax[0].text(5, 10.8, "10 A shell", fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("distance to catalytic core (A)")
ax[0].set_xlabel("PLAP mature residue number")
ax[0].set_title("ALPP residues by distance to the catalytic core, coloured by identity to ALPL\n"
                "blue identical, red different (PDB 1EW2, Needleman-Wunsch ALPP/ALPL alignment)", fontsize=10)
w = 10
mids, frac = [], []
for s in range(1, 480-w, w):
    sub = df[(df.mature >= s) & (df.mature < s+w)].dropna(subset=["identical"])
    if len(sub): mids.append(s+w/2); frac.append(sub.identical.mean()*100)
ax[1].bar(mids, frac, width=w*0.9, color=["#f0c419" if 366 <= m <= 430 else "#9aa5b1" for m in mids])
ax[1].axhline(100*rest.identical.mean(), ls="--", c="k", lw=1)
ax[1].text(470, 100*rest.identical.mean()+3, "chain background 54.8%", ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("% identity to ALPL\n(10-residue windows)"); ax[1].set_xlabel("PLAP mature residue number")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
